case_number: 2024 INSC 625; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 2622 OF 2024 (ARISING OUT OF SLP (CRL.) NO. 8081 OF 2023)
summary: Anticipatory bail under SC/ST (PoA) Act, 1989; Section 18 examined for bar on anticipatory bail; prima facie case under Sections 3(1)(r), 3(1)(u); intent to humiliate based on caste identity; knowledge of caste sufficient for offence; alleged defamatory video implicating MLA in corruption; publication as scheduled caste humiliation; bail denied due to prima facie allegations under PoA Act; jurisdictional conflict between criminal and departmental proceedings resolved.
legal_provisions_cited: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 s.3(1)(r)
Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 s.3(1)(u)
Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 s.18
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; anticipatory bail denied; High Court order upholding rejection of bail confirmed.
